title: Why Do We Sleep?
paragraphs: Every night, we go to sleep. Most adults sleep seven to nine hours. Children and teenagers need more sleep.
Sleep has steps. First, our sleep is light. Then it is deep. Later, we dream. This happens again and again in one night.
When we sleep, the body rests. The brain is busy too. It keeps the new things we learned in the day.
If we do not sleep well, we feel tired. It is hard to think and to be happy. Good sleep is important for everyone.
